description:
One trial-stage cell's ``record/trial.json`` (``pipeline.trial_record``).

What the cell's own snapshot and the watchlist say about its event: the
judge, the motion's briefing by entry, and the listed case's other dockets
by identifier.

assigned_judge.description: The judge the snapshot names as assigned; `null` where it names none
assigned_judge.title: Assigned Judge

briefing.description: `null` for the judgment event, which names no motion, and for a motion the opener does not read on this snapshot

case_id.description: The docket the cell is placed on
case_id.title: Case Id

listed_case.description: The watchlist's name for the case the docket belongs to; `null` where the watchlist names the docket nowhere
listed_case.title: Listed Case

moment.description: The trial moment the event belongs to
moment.title: Moment

referred_judge.description: The magistrate judge the snapshot names as referred to; `null` where it names none
referred_judge.title: Referred Judge

related_dockets.description: The listed case's dockets other than the cell's own
related_dockets.title: Related Dockets
